answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks by requiring costly, identity-bound proof of real work: each agent must maintain a resource ledger whose history is verifiable on-chain, so fabricating thousands of fake identities fails because no single sybil can accumulate enough attested attestations or locked collateral to pass the threshold. Just as a canyon, tundra, and karst each shape their terrain through slow geological accumulation, genuine reputation builds only through consistent, checkable contributions — making cloned identities economically worthless.
